passages.quote:
This notice replaces MIN 732 (M+F) amendment 2.

It should be read with:

The Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) (Minimum Requirements for Seafarers etc.) Regulations 2014

The Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018

MIN 734 (M+F) Welfare support for seafarers and fishers

This MIN expires 30 November 2026.

Notice to:

shipowners

masters

officers

ratings

offshore workers

crewing agents and trade unions; fishing vessel owners, operators and managers of fishing vessels, employers of fishers, skippers, officers and fishers.
